mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a kind of philosophy guiding the branch of knowledge (Learning) of teaching or instructional approaches."

There are two major categories of instructional materials namely (i) Projected and (ii) non-projected aids while the classification mode puts all instructional materials under three categories viz: (i) Visual aids (ii) Audio aids and (iii) Audio-Visual aids.
